title: Netherchat event stream (v1)
description: One newline-delimited JSON object per event from `netherchat tail --json` and `netherchat agent --json`. Metadata only by default — message bodies are emitted only with --include-bodies. The `v` field is the schema version and a stability contract: it is bumped only on a breaking change.

v.description: Schema version. Stability contract; bumped only on a breaking change.

actor.description: Display name of the acting member (not authenticated; judge identity by fpr).

fpr.description: SSH-format SHA256 fingerprint of the actor's identity key.

verified.description: Whether the local observer has SAS-verified the actor this session.

signed.description: Whether the message carried a valid Ed25519 signature.

body_len.description: Length in bytes of the decrypted message body.

body_hash.description: SHA-256 of the plaintext body, hex, prefixed sha256:.

body.description: The decrypted body. Present ONLY when --include-bodies is set (creates a local content record).

quorum.description: Running ack count '<acked>/<members>' from the emitting client's view (ack events).

target.description: Display name of the verified peer (verify events).

from.description: Display name of the prior incident commander (handoff events).

from_fpr.description: Fingerprint of the prior IC (handoff events).

to.description: Display name of the new incident commander (handoff events).

to_fpr.description: Fingerprint of the new IC (handoff events).

allowed.description: Whether the agent's allowlist permits the command (exec events).

trigger_rule.description: Index of the matched [[route]] rule (route_fired events).

invitees.description: Names invited to the spawned incident room (route_fired events).

ttl_seconds.description: Hard lifetime of the spawned incident room (route_fired events).

ttl_remaining.description: Seconds of room life remaining; always 0 for a scuttle (the room is gone).

filename.description: Sanitized artifact basename (file_offer / file_complete, §2.3) — metadata the relay never saw.

transfer_id.description: Content-free transfer id correlating an offer with its completion (file events).
